I added the three features to `Shop.Cart` in `lib/shop/cart.ex`, with tests in `test/shop/cart_test.exs`. All 15 tests pass.

- **`remove_item(cart, sku, quantity)`**: subtracts units. If you remove as many as the cart holds or more, the item is dropped. Removing a SKU (stock-keeping unit, the item ID) that isn't in the cart changes nothing.
- **`apply_discount(cart, code)`**: takes the typed string and returns `{:ok, cart}` or an error.
  - Matching is exact, so "save10" is unknown.
